text:
morgan: Quick proposal — cost-aware routing MVP. Route requests by customer tier+region, prefer `cheap-quant` variants for low tiers and only escalate to `base` when latency SLO or hallucination checks fail. We need per-request token-cost limits, per-route telemetry, and a simple Console toggle for customers to opt into cheaper variants.

alex: +1. Two clarifying q's: 1) how do we measure 'cheaper' at request time (tokens * model_unit_cost?), 2) rollback/escape hatch if quality drops.

morgan: For measurement: yes, estimate cost = input_tokens*ingest_unit + predicted_output_tokens*gen_unit (use 95th pctl). We'll emit estimated_token_cost and actual_token_cost metrics. For rollback: default is immediate fallback to pinned model for that customer if error rate or manual rollback triggered.

jamie: From Console UX: show an estimated per-response cost next to the route selector and a single toggle: "Prefer cost-optimized variants (may degrade quality)". Hover tooltip links to evaluation examples and recent regressions. Keep it opt-in for now.

ana: @ana (product) here — we need canary controls: percentage rollout + automatic quality gate based on eval set. Also expose a dashboard that maps cost savings vs regression rate.

ana: Also: legal/reg teams will want an audit trail of variant swaps by customer. Add event logs with model_variant, timestamp, trigger.

kevin: Implementation sketch for routing policy (runtime config):

```json
{"policy_name":"tiered_variant_fallback","rules":[{"match":{"tier":"low","region":"eu-?"},"prefer":"cheap-quant","fallbacks":["base-quant","base"],"cost_limit_per_request_cents":20,"latency_slo_ms":250}],"global_defaults":{"estimate_output_tokens_pct":0.6}}
```

Note: cost_limit_per_request_cents is a hard cap — runtime will reject or route to a cheaper stub if exceeded. We need kernel to expose estimated_output_tokens quickly.

tara: Telemetry/metrics we should create: `routing.variant.selected`, `routing.variant.fallback_reason`, `request.token_est_cost_cents`, `request.token_actual_cost_cents`, `request.quality_signal` (enum). Dashboard panels: cost delta by tier, fallback rate, avg latency by variant. I'll sketch a dashboard.

alex: About quotas: we should make quota enforcement aware of variant. Suggested model: per-customer token quota consumed is actual_token_usage * variant_cost_multiplier so we can keep user-facing quotas intuitive (e.g., tokens left). Alternatively expose both raw_tokens_remaining and cost_budget_remaining. Which do we prefer?

morgan: Lean toward exposing both. For billing accuracy we bill on actual_token_cost_cents. For UX, show "estimated tokens left" and "budget left". Also need server-side enforcement: if budget_left < 0, block or degrade.

ana: Rollouts UX: when enabling cost-optimized variant for a customer, offer a 7-day canary with automatic revert if quality_signals exceed threshold. Default quality_signals: rouge/semantic-check fail rate > 2% or user-reported spam > 0.5%.

kevin: Runtime note: cheap-quant variants currently have ~15% higher latency on long outputs due to decoding inefficiencies; add a heuristic to prefer base for requests where prompt_size > 2k tokens or expected_output > 1k.

morgan: Good call. Add rule: if expected_output_tokens > 1024 then prefer lower-latency base.

alex: Quick config tweak I suggest adding: `prefer_cost_variants_until` with a timestamp to allow automated revert. Example small change to the snippet: 

```json
{"rules":[{"match":{"tier":"low"},"prefer":"cheap-quant","prefer_until":"2025-05-01T00:00:00Z"}]}
```

morgan: Also adding a small server-side circuit breaker: if fallback_rate to base across customers > 10% sustained for 15m, auto-pause cheap-quant route globally and notify #incidents.

sre-bot: alert: routing-circuit-breaker triggered test at 1782103600 (simulated).

alex: For telemetry cardinality: tag metrics by tier, region, route_id, variant, and customer_id (hashed). Avoid per-request prompt hashes.

tara: I'll prototype dashboard panels and a tiny Console mock for the toggle + per-route estimated costs. Need copy for the tooltip and a short FAQ blurb.

morgan: Action items: 1) kevin — wire runtime hooks for estimated_output_tokens + cost estimation API (ETA 3 days). 2) tara — dashboard + Console mock (ETA 2 days). 3) ana — product copy + canary thresholds (ETA 2 days). 4) alex — quota design doc for dual token/budget enforcement (ETA 3 days). We'll sync tomorrow.

kevin: ack, starting on hooks.

alex: ack. Adding doc now.

tara: ack. Will post mock gif in this thread when ready. :eyes:

morgan: If anyone has objections to the `cost_limit_per_request_cents` hard cap approach speak now; otherwise we'll iterate on the param name and units.

ana: No objections from product — prefer cents for precision.

deploy-bot: canary deploy for routing-config-service v0.12.3 completed at 1782103750 — all checks passed.

morgan: Great. Thanks all. We'll keep the initial rollout internal to sandbox customers for 2 weeks before exposing to paid tenants.

jamie: tiny UX note: add a "why did I see the cheap variant" link on responses that opens a modal showing decision tree (tier -> region -> latency check -> cost_cap). That helps CS.

morgan: Good idea. Add to UI items.

alex: One last thing: add a weekly aggregated report (cost saved, regressions) to enterprise customers that opt-in.

morgan: Perfect. Posting these notes to the eng-doc after the meeting.

-- end of thread --
